name: General Fitness
definition: Improve broad physical capacity and consistency.

name: General Strength
definition: Increase force production across common movement patterns.

name: Maximal Strength
definition: Increase the highest force that can be produced in a movement.

name: Muscle Hypertrophy
definition: Increase skeletal-muscle size.

name: Muscular Endurance
definition: Sustain repeated muscular contractions or submaximal work.

name: Muscular Power
definition: Produce force rapidly.

name: Power Endurance
definition: Repeat high-power efforts with limited performance drop.

name: Strength Endurance
definition: Maintain force output over repeated efforts.

name: Aerobic Base
definition: Improve low-to-moderate intensity aerobic capacity.

name: VO2max / High Aerobic Capacity
definition: Improve maximal aerobic power.

name: Threshold Performance
definition: Improve sustainable high-aerobic intensity.

name: Anaerobic Capacity
definition: Improve tolerance and output during intense short-duration work.

name: Speed
definition: Improve acceleration or maximal sprint speed.

name: Agility / COD
definition: Improve acceleration, braking, direction change, and reactive movement.

name: Mobility
definition: Improve active control through useful joint ranges.

name: Flexibility
definition: Increase or maintain range of motion.

name: Balance
definition: Improve postural control and proprioception.

name: Body Composition Support
definition: Support energy expenditure and lean-mass retention/gain through exercise.

name: Sport Performance
definition: Improve capacities relevant to a chosen sport.

name: Technique / Skill
definition: Improve movement quality and technical efficiency.

name: Recovery
definition: Promote low-stress movement and readiness between harder sessions.
